records.title: National Scholarship Portal
records.snippet: Government of India scholarship portal for central and state scholarship schemes. Use NSP for verified scheme listings, OTR, applications, and status checks.

records.title: AICTE Student Development Schemes
records.snippet: AICTE student schemes including Pragati, Saksham and Swanath scholarships for technical education students. Verify current year guidelines on AICTE/NSP.

records.title: AP Jnanabhumi Scholarships
records.snippet: Andhra Pradesh Jnanabhumi portal for post-matric and related student scholarship services. Verify latest application status and scheme rules on the portal.

records.title: Telangana ePASS Scholarships
records.snippet: Telangana ePASS portal for pre-matric, post-matric and overseas scholarship services. Verify application windows and eligibility on the portal.

records.title: Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
records.snippet: AICTE Pragati is intended for girl students in technical education. Verify latest application route and eligibility on AICTE/NSP.

records.title: UGC Scholarships and Fellowships
records.snippet: UGC scholarship and fellowship information for higher education students. Verify active schemes and notifications on UGC and NSP.

records.title: MahaDBT Scholarship Portal
records.snippet: Maharashtra DBT portal for student scholarship schemes. Verify department-wise schemes, eligibility and deadlines on the portal.

records.title: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal
records.snippet: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal for post-matric scholarships. Verify scheme eligibility, status and deadlines on the portal.

records.title: Rajasthan SJE Scholarship Portal
records.snippet: Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment scholarship portal for state scholarship schemes. Verify current session dates and eligibility on official portal.

records.title: CBSE Single Girl Child Scholarship
records.snippet: CBSE scholarship information for eligible single girl child students. Verify current notification and application window on CBSE.

records.title: Buddy4Study Scholarship Listings
records.snippet: Trusted scholarship listing platform with government, corporate, foundation and private scholarship opportunities. Use as discovery source and verify original provider before publishing.

records.title: Vidyasaarathi Scholarship Portal

records.title: Foundation For Excellence Scholarship
